annotations.title: Compare countries' climate and disaster risk

description: Two to ten named countries side by side: overall risk score, class and world rank, and their climate, nature, social, governance and adaptation scores (0 to 100, higher is riskier; rank 1 is the riskiest of 194). To find the riskiest countries use rank_countries.

countries.description: ISO3 codes or names of 2 to 10 countries
